title: Origin story: Nightwarden
description: Nightwarden was the watch commander of the city that never slept, who learned that the night is not the enemy of the day but its rest. He keeps the dark hours safe — patrolling dreams' borders, turning back nightmares, and making sure the city sleeps. He has kept the watch for a hundred years.

description: Ranked abilities: Night watch — rank 100/100; Vigilance — rank 99/100; Nightmare combat — rank 97/100; Calm — rank 96/100; Courage — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Nightwarden
description: Powers: Nightmares fear him; The dark hours obey his patrol; He sees in perfect dark.

description: Recorded feats of endurance: A century of nights; Fought the incursion without rest.
